description: This file defines the Retireable interface in the OpenMRS project, specifying methods related to the retirement status of objects, including whether they are retired, who retired them, when, and the reason.

classes.name: Retireable
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing retirement status of objects in OpenMRS, including retired flag, retiree, retirement date, and reason.

methods.name: isRetired
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the object is retired; use getRetired() instead.

methods.name: getRetired
methods.description: Returns whether the object is retired.

methods.name: setRetired
methods.description: Sets the retirement status of the object.

methods.name: getRetiredBy
methods.description: Gets the user who retired the object.

methods.name: setRetiredBy
methods.description: Sets the user who retired the object.

methods.name: getDateRetired
methods.description: Gets the date when the object was retired.

methods.name: setDateRetired
methods.description: Sets the date when the object was retired.
